title: Misfitting With AI: How Blind People Verify and Contest AI Errors

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative semi-structured interviews and reflexive thematic analysis of 26 blind and low-vision users' experiences to evaluate how AI visual assistance technologies prioritize sighted norms and fail to support non-visual camera aiming and usage (misfitting).

Thematic analysis of user-reported real-world scenarios and interview data identifying how computer vision models misidentify or fail to recognize non-Western products, groceries, and cultural artifacts (e.g., traditional dress).

Analysis of participant interview accounts detailing the systemic failures and high error rates of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems when attempting to process non-English texts (e.g., Arabic, Korean, and Khmer).
